description: This file contains data transfer object (DTO) and request model definitions for the Asset management domain within a backend system. It defines persistent representations of database tables, as well as request payloads for creating and updating various asset-related entities, such as asset status logs, additional asset IDs, asset properties, control device mappings, input parameters, parent-child input mappings, reporting attribute mappings, EF source mappings, throughput equations and scalars, and data input values. The models are strictly shaped based on database schema and include validation rules, especially for required fields and conditional validation based on business rules.

classes.name: AssetStatusLogDto
classes.description: Represents a persisted log entry of an asset’s operational status, mapped to the 'asset_status_log' table.

classes.name: CreateAssetStatusLogRequest
classes.description: Payload for creating a new asset status log entry, includes validation for required fields.

classes.name: UpdateAssetStatusLogRequest
classes.description: Payload for updating an existing asset status log, with validation rules.

classes.name: AdditionalAssetIdDto
classes.description: Represents an additional identifier for an asset, mapped to the 'additional_asset_id' table.

classes.name: CreateAdditionalAssetIdRequest
classes.description: Payload for creating an additional asset ID, enforces required fields.

classes.name: UpdateAdditionalAssetIdRequest
classes.description: Payload for updating an existing additional asset ID, with validation.

classes.name: AssetPropertyDto
classes.description: Represents a property associated with an asset, mapped to 'asset_property'.

classes.name: CreateAssetPropertyRequest
classes.description: Payload to create a new asset property with validation.

classes.name: UpdateAssetPropertyRequest
classes.description: Payload to update an asset property, with validation.

classes.name: ControlDeviceMappingDto
classes.description: Represents a control device mapping related to an asset, mapped to 'control_device_mapping'.

classes.name: CreateControlDeviceMappingRequest
classes.description: Payload for creating a control device mapping.

classes.name: UpdateControlDeviceMappingRequest
classes.description: Payload for updating a control device mapping.

classes.name: InputParameterDto
classes.description: Represents an input parameter entity for assets, mapped to 'input_parameter'.

classes.name: CreateInputParameterRequest
classes.description: Payload for creating an input parameter; includes validation with conditional checks for UOM and reporting program dependencies.

classes.name: UpdateInputParameterRequest
classes.description: Payload for updating an input parameter, with similar validation.

classes.name: ParentInputMappingDto
classes.description: Represents a parent-child input parameter mapping, mapped to 'parent_input_mapping'.

classes.name: CreateParentInputMappingRequest
classes.description: Payload for creating a parent input mapping.

classes.name: UpdateParentInputMappingRequest
classes.description: Payload for updating a parent input mapping.

classes.name: ReportingAttributeMappingDto
classes.description: Represents a reporting attribute mapping, mapped to 'reporting_attribute_mapping'.

classes.name: CreateReportingAttributeMappingRequest
classes.description: Payload to create a reporting attribute mapping.

classes.name: UpdateReportingAttributeMappingRequest
classes.description: Payload to update a reporting attribute mapping.

classes.name: EfSourceMappingDto
classes.description: Represents an EF source mapping, mapped to 'ef_source_mapping'.

classes.name: CreateEfSourceMappingRequest
classes.description: Payload for creating an EF source mapping.

classes.name: UpdateEfSourceMappingRequest
classes.description: Payload for updating an EF source mapping.

classes.name: ThroughputEquationDto
classes.description: Represents a throughput equation, mapped to 'throughput_equation'.

classes.name: CreateThroughputEquationRequest
classes.description: Payload to create a throughput equation.

classes.name: UpdateThroughputEquationRequest
classes.description: Payload to update a throughput equation.

classes.name: ThroughputScalarDto
classes.description: Represents a throughput scalar, mapped to 'throughput_scalar'.

classes.name: CreateThroughputScalarRequest
classes.description: Payload for creating a throughput scalar.

classes.name: UpdateThroughputScalarRequest
classes.description: Payload for updating a throughput scalar.

classes.name: DataInputValueDto
classes.description: Represents a data input value, mapped to 'data_input_value'.

classes.name: CreateDataInputValueRequest
classes.description: Payload for creating a data input value.

classes.name: UpdateDataInputValueRequest
classes.description: Payload for updating a data input value.
